data.title: Jeweller's forceps
data.summary: Forceps & clamps · Plain-handled forceps that taper rapidly to very fine points, for atraumatic micro-handling.
data.body:
![Jeweller's forceps](instruments/jewellers-forceps.jpg)

_Also called: Watchmaker's forceps, Micro forceps_

Plain-handled forceps that taper rapidly to very fine points, for atraumatic micro-handling.

## Parts
- Elongated plain handles
- Rapid taper to a fine tip

## Types / variants
- Straight, curved or angled

## Uses / indications
- Atraumatic handling of skin grafts
- Hair transplantation (graft implantation)
- Suture removal
- Grasping small bleeders during electrocoagulation

## How to hold
Hold like a pen with the first three fingers (between thumb and middle finger, index finger steadying); grasp dermis rather than epidermis to avoid crushing the wound edge.

## Sterilisation & care
Autoclave, hot air oven, 2% glutaraldehyde or boiling
